answer: In an agent market trading wharf storage, shale, and quartz, each agent's voting power equals its tokens locked in escrow for 90 days, with no bonus for opening an account. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake identities still yields only 100 votes. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital and bearing price risk for the full period; creating identities alone buys no power.
